Alex — good news, we can support a short extension and a one-off credit to finish your validation. Details below: 

Offer (approved):
- 7-day trial extension starting on 2027-09-30.
- Promotional credit: $400 applied to your first invoice (covers ~50–60k tokens).

Terms (short):
- Credit is non-refundable and will be applied to the account invoice upon conversion.
- To maintain the promo, ClearPath agrees to provide a signed PO or intent-to-purchase (12-month minimum term) by 2027-10-13. If we do not receive the PO by that date the credit will be void.
- Attached: promo_terms_v2.pdf for legal/record.

Next steps for ClearPath:
1) Reply to confirm you accept these terms.
2) We will enable the 7-day extension on 2027-09-30.
3) If you can, share a PO or procurement timeline so we can track.

Ben / Marcus / Monica — thanks for the quick reviews and approvals. Marcus confirmed finance pre-authorization. Marcus, please confirm if you want us to route the final promo doc to legal or finance for signature.

Thanks — Hannah
